Plex currently needs atlas (its Docker host) and tank (library on tank/media and appdata on tank/appdata). The older titan dependency is superseded.

Direct: the Ollama endpoint on titan stops (it depends on titan being awake). Second hop: the wiki search service on hermes degrades; new wiki pages are not embedded, though keyword search still works.
The nightly rclone backup needs atlas (it runs there), tank (it reads the 05:45 tank snapshot) and gate (for internet access to upload).
The hermes VM needs atlas (it runs on atlas and stops when atlas stops) and tank (its vdisk is on tank/domains and it cannot boot without tank).

Syncing of the notes folder to pebble stops. Syncthing runs on atlas (depends_on atlas) and syncs tank/notes, and its link to pebble runs only over Tailscale, which runs on atlas and so also goes down.

Direct dependents of gate per its page: reverse-proxy (outside access to Plex and wiki search), tailscale (internet), rclone-backup (cloud upload), atlas's Unraid email notifications, and aria (its network address comes from gate DHCP). Second hop via tailscale: pebble (remote access to hermes and Plex) and syncthing (sync to pebble).

Directly it needs hermes, where it runs. Indirectly, hermes needs atlas and tank (hermes depends on both). Keyword queries do not need the Ollama endpoint on titan; that only affects embeddings of new pages.

Stopping with atlas: the tank pool, the hermes VM, Plex, the Caddy reverse proxy, Syncthing, the Tailscale plugin (exit node and subnet route) and the nightly rclone backup, all of which run on atlas. Through hermes, the wiki search service also stops.

Direct users of tank: Plex (library and appdata on tank), Syncthing (notes folder stops syncing to pebble), the nightly rclone backup (reads the tank snapshot), and the hermes VM (its vdisk is on tank/domains). Through hermes, the wiki search service also stops; the reverse proxy would still run but Plex behind it would fail.

If hermes is down, the wiki search service (qmd) that runs on it stops, the wiki repo at /srv/wiki is unavailable, and the nightly search index rebuild does not run so the index goes stale. Remote access from pebble to hermes is also lost. The reverse proxy fronts the wiki search service, so that route fails too.
